title-small.purpose: Headings inside tiles; the same face sets facts on home tiles and the ticker.

figure.purpose: Big class times, prices and totals; counts up into view.

menu.purpose: Links in the open menu panel.

index.purpose: Tile numbering such as 01 or A1.

punchline.purpose: Inter italic line under the home title; picked-out words at 800 in Gold Ink.

shadows.name: control-lift

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: White tiles and cards on paper.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve for presses, menu, blur fade and ripples.

motion.name: ease-expo
motion.purpose: Home entrance: header slide (950ms) and title lines rising (1000ms, 85ms apart).

motion.name: ease-quart
motion.purpose: Home entrance of punchline, lede and actions (700 to 800ms).

motion.name: ease-quint
motion.purpose: Tile columns gliding in, handing over to the drift at 2100ms.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pill and round control on press.

motion.name: ripple
motion.purpose: Ring spreading from the press point on pills and circles.

motion.name: tile-drift
motion.value: 14.6s linear infinite, alternating up and down

motion.name: shine-border
motion.purpose: Gold thread round the title tile word.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.purpose: Gold sweep across Get directions on home.

motion.name: ticker
motion.purpose: Gold strip above the footer; pauses on hover.

motion.name: confetti
motion.value: 1600ms, 110 pieces in gold, gold light, navy, raised navy, cream

motion.name: menu-open
motion.purpose: Menu panel inside the header card.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stops drift, shine, shimmer, ticker, rotate, ripple, fades, tickers, confetti and the entrance; hides the pause button.

grain.value: fractal-noise SVG; multiply .13 on light tiles, screen .035 on dark
grain.purpose: Kept on purpose on every solid tile (owner decision).

narrative.overview:
The site is a wall of rounded tiles on warm paper. Each tile holds one thing: a photo from the academy's Instagram, a block of navy or gold, or a single fact in heavy uppercase ("Every Thursday", "7:30pm", "£7 a class", "Gidea Park"). On the home page the wall drifts up and down beside the academy's name, set huge in Archivo. The last word of the name sits on a navy tile of its own, ringed by a thin thread of moving gold light. Inner pages use the same tiles as their content blocks under a big two-voice page head: ink, then gold. The energy comes from motion, scale and real photos, never from ornament. Around that, a floating white header card, a gold ticker strip and a dark rounded footer keep the layout clean and confident.

The feel is festive but polished. The type is loud and tightly tracked. The surfaces are flat with soft corners. The palette is navy and gold, the brand colours, set on a pale warm paper instead of a dark ground, so the page reads as daylight and welcome. A fine grain on the solid tiles gives them a printed, tactile quality. That grain is a deliberate decision, not leftover texture. Every effect (shimmer, shine, word rotate, ripple, blur fade, number tickers, confetti, the drift and the ticker) is plain CSS or small vanilla JS in the spirit of Magic UI, and all of them stop for visitors who ask for reduced motion.

The brand's refusals are carried from PRODUCT.md: no clichéd "Indian" decoration (paisley, mandalas, Bollywood clip-art), and no quiet, plain page without Bhangra's energy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#f5f4ef) with navy, gold, cream and white tiles at a 22px radius.
Archivo 900, uppercase, tracked tight (-0.035em to -0.06em), for every heading and every fact on a tile.
Titles in two voices: ink, then the last word in gold.
Inter for reading, with Inter italic as the punchline voice.
Flat surfaces. Depth comes from tone, hairline rings and grain; the only real shadows are on the floating header card and the pause button.
Motion that is constant but calm (drift, shine, ticker), with a pause button and a full stop under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Gold Ink Rule
rules.body: Gold type on paper or white is always Gold Ink (#7d6130); Festival Gold (#c9a463) is a fill, or type on navy only. Festival Gold on paper fails contrast.

rules.name: The Brand Pair Rule
rules.body: Navy and gold are the only chromatic colours. Every other surface is paper, cream or white. Confetti is drawn from the same five colours (gold, gold light, navy, raised navy, cream).

rules.name: The Dark Ground Logo Rule
rules.body: The round badge always sits on black or dark navy, never straight on paper or white; in the header it sits in a black circle.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Every big title splits into ink and gold: everything but the last word in ink, the last word in gold (Gold Ink on paper, Festival Gold on navy). On the home page, the last word moves onto its own navy tile.

rules.name: The Uppercase Display Rule
rules.body: Archivo is always uppercase and always tracked negative at heading sizes. Inter is never uppercase, except for the logo's small tagline and the footer column headings.

rules.name: The Grain Stays Rule
rules.body: Every solid tile carries the grain overlay. It is part of the material, by the owner's decision; do not remove it or swap it for a gradient.

rules.name: The Two Floaters Rule
rules.body: Only things that float over moving or scrolling content (the header card, the pause button) cast a shadow. Tiles never do.

dos: **Do** build every content block as a 22px tile in one of the six tones, on warm paper.
**Do** set titles in Archivo 900 uppercase with negative tracking, and split them into two voices (ink, then the last word in gold).
**Do** use Gold Ink (#7d6130) for any gold type on paper or white, and Festival Gold (#c9a463) only as a fill or as type on navy.
**Do** keep the grain overlay on solid tiles.
**Do** pair the main pill with its 64px round partner and keep tap targets at least 44px.
**Do** switch every effect off under reduced motion, and give any loop longer than five seconds a pause control.
**Do** let real photos from Instagram fill the photo tiles, on a midnight ground.
donts: **Don't** use clichéd "Indian" decoration: generic paisley, mandalas or Bollywood clip-art.
**Don't** make a quiet, plain page with no sense of Bhangra's energy.
**Don't** put the round badge straight on paper or white; it sits on black or dark navy.
**Don't** add drop shadows to tiles, or hard offset shadows anywhere; only the header card and the pause button float.
**Don't** use square corners on public surfaces.
**Don't** introduce chromatic colours beyond navy and gold.
